verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 for managing all compute resources, plus a GraphQL API, SDKs (Python/JS/Go), and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, giving comprehensive programmatic/agentic access. Missing for 10: no publicly hosted OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe returned 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond first-party docs.
